{{Quote|His code name is Phalanx. He has vital information on Hutt dealings with the Sith.|Jax Dumont|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Jax Dumont''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Stardogs]], a group of Republic veterans that fought against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When his fellow veteran [[Phalanx (individual)|Phalanx]] was captured by the Empire on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Jax tasked a spacer to rescue him since he carried important intel on the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] dealings with the Empire.
